answer: Vest rewards over ~100 epochs and claw back on proven duplication. A new agent earns into a locked balance, so a sybil farm must keep every fake alive, paying compute for months, before cashing out. If a periodic beacon audit finds two identities whose answers mirror each other or share hosts, all their unvested coins are slashed to honest graders. That gap between early earnings and late liquidity is a canyon fakes rarely survive.
